name: Fiverr

buyer.notes: plus a 3.50 USD small-order fee under 200 USD (secondary)

fees.notes: 20% flat on orders, extras and tips (secondary aggregators citing the Payment Terms).

splitMechanism: Order extras and hourly orders exist; a native milestone mechanism is unknown. Earnings clear 14 days after completion (7 for Top Rated, Pro, Seller Plus; secondary).

contactPolicy.notes: Third-party communication only after an order is placed; records stay on the platform.

automation.notes: Prohibited Services and Community Standards not fully read (unknown). Seller onboarding (src/platforms/fiverr/onboarding.mjs, mapped 2026-10-26): about an hour into filling the profile in the operator's Chrome, the onboarding page answered with the PerimeterX human check (PXCR error code). A run stops there and reports it; passing the press-and-hold on the operator's own signed-in session is the step not built yet.

aiPolicy: AI is allowed when used responsibly, refined and customized; honor a client request for no AI and disclose the workflow; deepfakes, unauthorized likeness and fraud are banned.

market.notes: The owned headless browser met a PerimeterX challenge on 2026-10-25 while the operator's Chrome read the same search page, and Wayback holds search captures from 2016 and 2017 only. In the operator's Chrome the first search of a session read 30 to 48 gigs at 11:26 and 12:36 UTC, and a second search 8 s after the first met the challenge, so one search an hour refreshes all 13 catalog queries within the day.

rankingSignals: response rate is the first reply within 24 hours over the last 90 days
